terms.comment: Lewis & Short calls it “the wild mountain-ash”. The identification is uncertain: botanists use the word for the manna or flowering ash (Fraxinus ornus), a small ash of southern hills; the rowan, which English also calls mountain ash, is a different tree.

phrases.latin: flūminibus salicēs crassīsque palūdibus alnī nāscuntur, sterilēs saxōsīs montibus ornī
phrases.english: willows grow by rivers and alders in thick marshes, barren ashes on rocky hills

sources: Lewis & Short: ornus
